title: Senior Developer Experience Platform Engineer
jobDescription:
As passionate about our people as we are about our mission. Why Join Q2? Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers. What Makes Q2 Special? Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways, including our “Circle of Awesomeness” award ceremony and day of employee celebration among others! We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, mentorship programs, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun. We hold an annual Dodgeball for Charity event at our Q2 Stadium in Austin, inviting other local companies to play, and community organizations we support to raise money and awareness together. SUMMARY About the Role We're looking for an experienced infrastructure-minded engineer who's passionate about improving developer productivity and platform scalability. In this role, you'll help design, build, and automate the foundational systems that power our engineering teams
- from code to production. Here's a quick snapshot of what we're looking for: Proficiency in Python and equivalent language and Infrastructure based Problem Solving and System Design. Strong experience with Docker or Kubernetes Hands-on experience with AWS Cloud. Solid understanding Git-based workflows, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi A passion for building self-service developer platforms and improving reliability. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain platform components such as container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes or Nomad), infrastructure as code, and observability tools. Develop self-service tools and abstractions to simplify deployment, scaling, and operations for product engineering teams. Collaborate with developers, architects, and SREs to ensure platform solutions meet their needs and promote best practices around reliability, security, and performance. Write high-quality, reusable code and automation scripts that reduce toil and increase repeatability across environments. Monitor system health and performance; drive improvements in observability, alerting, and incident response. Document platform standards and conduct knowledge-sharing sessions to raise platform literacy across the org. Qualifications Required: 5-8 years of experience in software engineering, cloud, infrastructure or SRE roles. Strong experience with Kubernetes or Nomad, containerization, and related ecosystem tools (e.g., Helm, Traefik, Vault). Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python). Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS). Deep understanding of CI/CD systems and version control workflows (e.g., Git Lab, Git Hub Actions). Experience in all aspects of the software development life cycle Solid knowledge of infrastructure-as-code practices using tools like Terraform or Pulumi. Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills across the stack (compute, networking, storage, etc.). Preferred: Experience working with Git Ops-based workflows. Familiarity with secrets management, service mesh, and RBAC in cloud-native environments. Exposure to monitoring/logging stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or Open Telemetry. Background in fintech, Saa S, or other high-availability, high-security environments is a plus. RESPONSIBILITIES • Design, implement, integrate, and test software solutions of moderate complexity, including Windows- and Linux-based front-end and back-end components. • Deliver solutions in live production systems individually and collaboratively. • Support, maintain, and resolve issues for custom features in production systems; occasional on-call availability may be required. • Ensure adherence to all security, availability, confidentiality, and privacy policies and controls. • Assist and mentor teammates, providing technical leadership and advocating best practices. EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience. • 5–8 years of software development experience. • Full-stack .NET development (SQL Server, C#, HTML/CSS, Java Script). • Familiarity with MVVM and front-end frameworks (Vue, Angular, React). • Experience with test automation frameworks and auto-mocking tooling. • Practical experience with multiple design patterns and SOLID principles. • Domain experience in banking is a plus. • Proficiency in Python and SQL. • Web development experience. • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. • Experience in all aspects of the software development life cycle and service-oriented architecture. • Experience in Agile development environments. • Ability to work flexible hours and provide occasional on-call/emergency support. This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English. Our Culture & Commitment: We’re proud to foster a supportive, inclusive environment where career growth, collaboration, and wellness are prioritized. And our benefits go beyond healthcare—offering resources for physical, mental, and professional well-being. Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer. Q2 employees are encouraged to give back through volunteer work and nonprofit support through our Spark Program (see more). We believe in making an impact—in the industry and in the community. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status. Mission Q2’s mission is to build strong and diverse communities by strengthening their financial institutions. That mission shapes the technology we build, how we serve our customers, and how we show up for each other. Vision We started with a straightforward belief: technology could fundamentally change how financial institutions serve their communities. More than 20 years later, that belief still drives us. Q2 delivers digital banking and lending solutions that help financial institutions deepen relationships, improve experiences, and grow. Across every department and region, Q2 team members bring creativity, collaboration, and purpose to building technology that makes banking stronger, easier, and more human. Culture & Values Q2’s culture is built by Q2ers and grounded in ten guiding principles that define how we show up for each other, our customers, and our communities. We take our mission seriously. We also have fun doing it. Teams across the company work together to solve hard problems, move quickly, and make a real impact on the financial institutions and communities we serve. We’re also helping shape how AI is applied in financial services, bringing the same disciplined, banking-first approach Q2 has practiced for more than 20 years to this next chapter of innovation.

Preferred Qualifications Experience in fintech, digital banking, payments, lending, fraud, or regulated enterprise environments. Expertise in AI-assisted product experiences, intelligent automation, personalization systems, or enterprise AI governance. SUMMARY Q2 is seeking a highly motivated Lead Platform Engineer – Cloud Platform (AWS) to lead the engineering, operations, and continuous improvement of highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure supporting our mission-critical financial services platform. As a technical lead within the Platform Engineering organization, you will drive the adoption of Platform Engineering principles, champion automation, and build resilient cloud-native infrastructure with AWS as the primary cloud platform. You will also contribute to Azure-based initiatives as business needs evolve and should be comfortable working in a multi-cloud environment. Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus. You will collaborate closely with Product Engineering, Dev Ops, Security, Architecture, and Infrastructure teams to build reliable platform services, improve developer productivity, and deliver secure, scalable cloud solutions. Key Responsibilities Technical Lead & Engineering Serve as the technical lead for cloud platform engineering initiatives. Drive the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cloud platform services. Define engineering standards, platform best practices, and technical roadmaps. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers across Platform Engineering teams. Lead technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and implementation planning. Drive cloud modernization and automation. Cloud Platform Engineering Design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and highly available AWS infrastructure. Support Azure platform engineering initiatives and contribute to multi-cloud solutions as business needs evolve. Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is desirable but not required. Design and manage AWS networking services including VPC, Route 53, Transit Gateway, Security Groups, Network ACLs, NAT Gateways, Internet Gateways, VPNs, Direct Connect, and Application/Network Load Balancers (ALB/NLB). Build and operate Kubernetes platforms (Amazon EKS preferred; AKS experience is beneficial). Manage container platforms including Docker, Amazon ECR (or equivalent container registries), container image lifecycle management, and artifact repositories. Design secure multi-account cloud environments with IAM, governance, networking, and security best practices. Build reusable Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) using Terraform. Develop self-service platform capabilities that improve developer productivity and reduce operational overhead. Optimize cloud performance, scalability, availability, and cost using Fin Ops best practices. Implement backup, disaster recovery, and high availability strategies. Automation & Platform Engineering Develop platform automation using Python, Bash, or Go. Collaborate with Dev Ops and application engineering teams to integrate Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Kubernetes, and platform services into CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. Promote Git Ops practices and standardized deployment methodologies. Continuously improve platform automation and self-service capabilities. Observability & Operations Design and implement end-to-end observability solutions using Open Telemetry (OTel), Amazon Cloud Watch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK/Open Search, or similar platforms. Build monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting capabilities to improve platform visibility and reliability. Participate in an on-call rotation supporting business-critical production systems. Security & Governance Implement AWS security best practices, IAM governance, encryption, and least-privilege access. Partner with Security teams to remediate vulnerabilities and maintain compliance. Support audit readiness, governance, and platform security initiatives. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years of experience in Dev Ops, Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or Infrastructure Engineering. 5+ years of experience with public cloud platforms, with strong expertise in AWS. Working knowledge of Azure is expected, and exposure to GCP is a plus. Strong expertise with AWS services including EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS, ECS, S3, EBS, RDS, Route 53, Cloud Watch, Auto Scaling, ALB/NLB, KMS, Transit Gateway, VPN, and Direct Connect. Strong understanding of AWS networking architecture, hybrid connectivity, DNS, routing, load balancing, and security. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (Amazon EKS preferred; AKS experience is beneficial). Hands-on experience with Docker, Amazon ECR (or equivalent container registries), container lifecycle management, and artifact repositories. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. Experience integrating Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and platform automation into modern CI/CD workflows using Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, Azure Dev Ops, Git Lab CI, or similar platforms. Strong scripting and programming skills using Python, Bash, or Go. Strong Linux administration experience. Experience implementing monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability solutions using Open Telemetry (OTel), Cloud Watch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Open Search, Datadog, or similar technologies. Strong troubleshooting, production support, and incident management skills. Experience serving as a technical lead, providing engineering guidance, and driving cross-functional technical initiatives. Preferred Qualifications Experience working across AWS and Azure cloud environments. Experience with Git Ops tools such as Argo CD or Flux. Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd. Experience with distributed systems such as Kafka or Redis. Knowledge of Policy-as-Code and cloud security automation. Experience implementing Fin Ops practices and cloud cost optimization. Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries. AWS Professional Certification preferred. Azure and/or Google Cloud certifications are a plus. Kubernetes certifications (CKA or CKS) are a plus. Core Competencies Platform Engineering AWS Cloud Architecture Azure Cloud Kubernetes (EKS/AKS) Docker & Container Platforms AWS Networking Infrastructure as Code frameworks i.e. Terraform/Crossplane Automation & Scripting Git Ops Observability (Open Telemetry, Cloud Watch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Open Search) Cloud Security & Governance Incident & Problem Management Operational Excellence Technical Leadership & Mentoring Cross-functional Collaboration Success Measures Improve platform availability, reliability, and resiliency. Reduce operational toil through automation. Increase platform scalability and engineering efficiency. Optimize cloud performance and cost. Deliver secure, scalable, reusable platform services that improve the developer experience. Drive engineering excellence through technical guidance, automation, platform innovation, and operational best practices. This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English. SUMMARY As a Senior Product Owner supporting Q2’s Commercial product team, you will translate customer needs into actionable product features and orchestration platform. You will act as a bridge between Product Management, engineering, and business stakeholders, ensuring that business requirements are clearly communicated and effectively implemented. This role requires strong technical understanding, operational discipline, and customer-centric thinking. Proven experience in US Payments, specifically Wires and ACH. Experience with Integrated Payables is desirable. You will manage the product backlog, define user stories with clear acceptance criteria, and drive timely delivery of enhancements that protect financial institutions while delivering a seamless customer experience. In addition, you will proactively analyze trends, recommend improvements to various models, and help shape the strategic roadmap of the business. This is a highly collaborative and client-facing role that demands attention to detail, technical aptitude, and the ability to work across multiple teams and functions. RESPONSIBILITIES • Develop a deep understanding of financial institution requirements. • Maintain and groom the product backlog; write clear user stories with acceptance criteria. • Collaborate with engineering, data science, and fraud operations to refine, test, and deploy features. • Assess trends and recommend real-time adjustments to models and risk thresholds. • Facilitate Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. • Remove obstacles and address dependencies that impede team progress. • Ensure alignment between product strategy and sprint execution. • Work with UX designers to create intuitive interfaces for product features. • Support QA efforts by defining test cases and acceptance criteria. • Act as the voice of the customer within the development team. • Engage with clients to optimize fraud prevention strategies. • Document product features, user stories, and requirements in Jira and Confluence. • Monitor and report sprint progress and assist in user acceptance testing with customers. EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field. • 5–8 years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst in financial services or Saa S. • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology and backlog management. • Experience engaging with clients to optimize product strategies. • Strong project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills. • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft Office suite. • Scrum Master or Product Owner certification preferred but not required. • Excellent facilitation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration abilities. • Working knowledge of accessibility guidelines (WCAG) applied across product, design, and engineering to support inclusive user experiences. This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English. SUMMARY: Q2 is seeking a Lead Operations Analyst to join our Strategic Operations Team. In this role, you'll be responsible for overseeing key operational initiatives, leveraging tools like Salesforce, Jira, Python, SQL, Power BI and advanced Excel. You will support operational transitions and business operations by developing capacity models, analysing performance trends, building insightful dashboards, and collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure programs are delivered on schedule and within budget. This incumbent must have strong analytics-first mindset leveraging statistical techniques, historical trend analysis, and the integration of multiple data sources to create short- and long-term forecasts, scenario models that support both strategic and tactical decision-making across the business.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Data Analysis and Reporting: Collect, analyse and interpret operational data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement. Design, develop and maintain dashboards and reports to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to capacity, cost and delivery timelines. Present data-driven insights, forecasts, and recommendations to senior leadership through clear, concise, and actionable reporting. Build and manage what-if, scenario-based, and forecasting models for project P&L, capacity planning, and resource allocation Process Improvement: Analyse existing operational workflows and performance metrics to identify efficiency gaps and optimization opportunities. Develop and implement process improvement strategies to increase efficiency and reduce costs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement changes and monitor their impact. Project Management: Provide analytical support to strategic initiatives and operational programs by tracking progress, performance, and risks through data and dashboards Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure alignment on objectives, timelines, and success metrics, with a focus on insight generation. Coordinating any major transitions within the company, such as financial, technological, operational, and governance changes. EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE: 8+ years of experience with a Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of experience with a Master's degree in a similar role Strong analytics-first mindset with proven problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities Hands-on experience with advanced Excel, SQL, and Python for data analysis, modelling, and reporting Working knowledge of analytics and operational tools such as Jira, Salesforce, Power BI, Qualtrics, or similar platforms Demonstrated experience building dashboards, data models, documentation, and analytical deliverables using tools such as Excel, Power Point, and Word; familiarity with visualization and process-mapping tools (e.g., Visio, Lucid chart) is a plus Experience managing stakeholder expectations and providing data-driven recommendations in dynamic, fast-paced environments Ability to develop new initiatives and processes that produce higher levels of customer satisfaction while reducing expenses and shortening project durations. Collaborative team player with excellent written and verbal communication skills and a client-first mindset Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent people and teamwork skills. Attention to detail, exceptional follow-through, the ability to prioritize, stay organized, and multi-task in a fast-paced environment. Prior experience with Salesforce (or other CRM tools) and Share Point preferred. Financial Services and enterprise software experience preferred. Experience building documentation and project plans using MS Project, Excel, Word, and Power Point. This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.
